For the Petitioner/Applicant : Mr. Syed Tafazzul Sajid, Adv. For the State : Mr. Shree Prakash Jha,
A.P.P.
----
th 02/Dated: 19 January, 2023
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned counsel for the State.

2. The applicant who is in custody since 24.09.2022 has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Ramna P.S. Case No.100 of 2022, registered for the offence under Sections 376, 417 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. It appears that the applicant is accused of committing rape upon the victim on the false pretext of marriage.
From perusal of the FIR it appears that they were in live-in relationship and this applicant was taking care of the children also.

4. It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of FIR along with its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on his part.
5. Innocence has been claimed by the learned counsel for the applicant and undertaking has been given for participation in the trial.
Further, it has been submitted that even if the allegation is accepted, relationship was consensual.
On the above basis, prayer for bail has been made.

7. Considering the narratives of the case and the period of custody, the applicant, named above, is directed to be released on bail, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand Only)
with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned A.C.J.M., Nagar Untari,
Garhwa in connection with Ramna P.S. Case No.100 of 2022, subject to condition that the applicant will submit self-attested photocopy of his Aadhaar Card and also submit his mobile number before the learned court below which he will always keep active and will not change it during pendency of this case without prior permission of the court.

(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Amar/-
